title: Find the district IDs where (1) the total transaction amount in 1997 exceed
question: Find the district IDs where (1) the total transaction amount in 1997 exceeded $10,000, and (2) at least one account in that district was opened in or after 1997 and is linked to a junior credit card issued on or after January 1, 1997.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_017"
FROM district AS d
WHERE d."XCL_017" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM account AS a
    INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1997'
    GROUP BY a."XCL_002"
    HAVING SUM(t."XCL_051") > 10000
)
AND d."XCL_017" IN (
    SELECT a2."XCL_002"
    FROM account AS a2
    INNER JOIN disp AS dp ON a2."XCL_001" = dp."XCL_015"
    INNER JOIN card AS c ON dp."XCL_013" = c."XCL_006"
    WHERE a2."XCL_004" >= '1997-01-01'
      AND c."XCL_007" = 'junior'
      AND c."XCL_008" >= '1997-01-01'
)
ORDER BY d."XCL_017"

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT d."XCL_017"
FROM district AS d
WHERE d."XCL_017" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM account AS a
    INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1997'
    GROUP BY a."XCL_002"
    HAVING SUM(t."XCL_051") > 10000
)
AND d."XCL_017" IN (
    SELECT a2."XCL_002"
    FROM account AS a2
    INNER JOIN disp AS dp ON a2."XCL_001" = dp."XCL_015"
    INNER JOIN card AS c ON dp."XCL_013" = c."XCL_006"
    WHERE a2."XCL_004" >= '1997-01-01'
      AND c."XCL_007" = 'junior'
      AND c."XCL_008" >= '1997-01-01'
)
ORDER BY d."XCL_017"

SELECT d."XCL_017"
FROM district AS d
WHERE d."XCL_017" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM account AS a
    INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1997'
    GROUP BY a."XCL_002"
    HAVING SUM(t."XCL_051") > 10000
)
AND d."XCL_017" IN (
    SELECT a2."XCL_002"
    FROM account AS a2
    INNER JOIN disp AS dp ON a2."XCL_001" = dp."XCL_015"
    INNER JOIN card AS c ON dp."XCL_013" = c."XCL_006"
    WHERE a2."XCL_004" >= '1997-01-01'
      AND c."XCL_007" = 'junior'
      AND c."XCL_008" >= '1997-01-01'
)
ORDER BY d."XCL_017"

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT d."XCL_017"
FROM district AS d
INNER JOIN account AS a ON d."XCL_017" = a."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
WHERE strftime('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1997'
GROUP BY d."XCL_017"
HAVING SUM(t."XCL_051") > 10000
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM account AS a2
  INNER JOIN disp AS dp ON a2."XCL_001" = dp."XCL_015"
  INNER JOIN card AS c ON dp."XCL_013" = c."XCL_006"
  WHERE a2."XCL_002" = d."XCL_017"
    AND a2."XCL_004" >= '1997-01-01'
    AND c."XCL_007" = 'junior'
    AND c."XCL_008" >= '1997-01-01'
)
ORDER BY d."XCL_017"
LIMIT 1
